# Results — Study 809 (Signed Jump Variation)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The claim under test —
Barndorff-Nielsen, Kinnebrock & Shephard (2010) realized **semivariance**; Bollerslev, Li &
Zhao (2020): split a name's realized variance into upside `RS+ = Σ r²·1(r>0)` and downside
`RS- = Σ r²·1(r<0)`; the scaled **signed jump variation** `SJ = (RS+ − RS-)/RV` is priced
**negatively** (downside-dominated names carry a premium), so a long-low-SJ / short-high-SJ
book should earn a positive spread. Offline & deterministic once cached; run
`python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every number. As-of **2026-06-30** (the last
complete calendar month; the partial current month is dropped). Fingerprint `357fd262912f`
(panel Close).*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Real tape | yfinance daily OHLC (`auto_adjust=True`, total-return), **50 liquid US large-caps**, 2010-01-04 → 2026-06-30 (as-of 2026-06-30), **4,147** dated rows/name |
| Universe | a fixed `UNIVERSE` of ~50 mega-caps, pulled through the **`quantlab.universe` survivorship guard** (`download_panel(..., allow_survivorship_bias=True)`), cached under this study's own `_cache/` |
| Signal | each name's **trailing-21-day signed jump variation** `SJ = (RS+ − RS-)/RV` of daily simple returns (upside minus downside realized semivariance, scaled by realized variance, in `[-1, +1]`), known at the close of `t−1` (one `shift`) |
| Sort | each day rank the cross-section by the signal; **long the bottom 30%** (low / negative SJ — downside-dominated), **short the top 30%** (high SJ — upside-dominated), equal-weight; measure the day-`t` forward return of each book |
| Execution / costs | one documented lag: signal through close `t−1` → hold day `t`. The costed timer charges 2 sides × one-way cost × NAV per day on the long-short book; the short book pays 50 bps/yr borrow |
| Statistics | Newey-West (HAC, 10-lag) *t* on the daily spread; one-sample *t*; Welch *t* on the pooled low-vs-high books; a 1,000-permutation placebo; a 20-seed synthetic positive control |

**Survivorship — named on the Signal axis.** `UNIVERSE` is a **current-membership** list of
names that are liquid mega-caps *today*, so the magnitudes are an **upper bound**. The signed
jump / downside-variance premium is documented as a broad cross-sectional effect that is
strongest among smaller, less-liquid names; a 50-mega-cap survivor panel is exactly where it
is *least* likely to appear — which is what we find.

## The headline — long-low-SJ / short-high-SJ spread

Daily equal-weight bottom-30% (low SJ) minus top-30% (high SJ) signed-jump spread
(n = **4,126** days, median 50 names/day):

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| **spread (long low-SJ − short high-SJ)** | **−1.71 bps/day** |
| Newey-West(10) *t* | **−1.36** |
| one-sample *t* | −1.29 |
| low-SJ book / high-SJ book | +7.20 bps / +8.91 bps (Welch *t* = −0.66) |
| gross spread Sharpe (no cost) | −0.32 |

The claimed edge **fails to replicate.** Bollerslev-Li-Zhao predict a *positive* long-low-SJ /
short-high-SJ spread (downside-dominated names out-earn); on this mega-cap universe the spread
is **statistically indistinguishable from zero** (−1.71 bps/day, NW *t* = **−1.36**, |*t*| < 2)
**and** the point estimate carries the **opposite sign** — the upside-dominated ("good"
volatility, high-SJ) names, if anything, *out-earned* the downside names over 2010–2026 (these
are the momentum tech mega-caps whose upside variance paid off). There is no reliable signed-jump
premium on 50 mega-caps.

## Placebo — is the (weak, reversed) tilt even a lucky alignment of the sort?

Keep the trailing signed-jump sort but read each day's forward returns from a **column-permuted**
panel (signal → outcome link broken), 1,000 permutations (20 seeds × 50):

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| observed spread | **−1.71 bps** |
| placebo mean (sd) | +0.025 bps (0.899) |
| position of observed | ≈ **1.9σ into the left tail** (right-tail p = 0.974) |

The permutation null centres at zero; the observed −1.71 bps sits only ≈1.9σ into the **left**
tail — not even the (opposite-sign) tilt clears a 2σ bar. Consistent with the insignificant
Newey-West *t*: there is nothing here.

## Robustness — two eras (split 2018-01-01)

| era | spread | NW *t* |
|---|--:|--:|
| 2010-01 → 2018-01 (n=1,992) | −0.35 bps | **−0.26** |
| 2018-01 → 2026-06 (n=2,134) | −2.98 bps | **−1.44** |

Neither half is significant; the (mild, wrong-signed) tilt is a recent-era, sub-2σ wobble, not a
stable premium.

## The timer — can you get paid for it?

Charge 2 sides × one-way × NAV per day on the long-short book; short pays 50 bps/yr borrow.

| one-way cost | gross/day | cost/day | net/day | *t* (net) | Sharpe (net) | ~ann. |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **1 bp** | −1.71 bps | 2.14 bps | **−3.85 bps** | −2.89 | −0.72 | −9.7%/yr |
| **5 bps** | −1.71 bps | 10.14 bps | **−11.85 bps** | −8.91 | −2.20 | −29.9%/yr |

The specified book loses money gross (insignificantly) and bleeds outright once friction is
charged; even the *sign-flipped* book (long high-SJ) earns only +1.71 bps/day gross, which the
2.14 bps/day round-trip friction at a mere 1 bp one-way already eats. **Mirage** either way.

## Synthetic positive control — the machinery is unbiased

Deterministic seeded panel with a persistent latent "asymmetry tilt" that shapes whether each
name's variance is upside- or downside-dominated and (with `edge>0`) depresses its forward mean.
No network.

| world | spread NW *t* |
|---|--:|
| null (`edge = 0`), **20 seeds** | mean **−0.31** (sd 0.82), **\|t\| ≥ 2 in 0/20 seeds** |
| planted (`edge = 0.0024`, seed 809) | **+3.66** (Welch *t* = +3.57) |

The detector recovers a *planted* Bollerslev-Li-Zhao negative-SJ relation cleanly (positive
long-low-SJ spread) and never fires on the null — so the flat real-tape result is a genuine
*absence* of the premium on the mega-cap universe, not a broken engine.
*(A faithful-engine / power check only — never cited in support of the real-tape stamp.)*

## Verdict

- **Signal — NONE.** The Bollerslev-Li-Zhao / realized-semivariance signed-jump premium does
  **not** replicate on 50 liquid US mega-caps. The specified long-low-SJ / short-high-SJ spread
  is **−1.71 bps/day** (NW *t* = **−1.36**, |*t*| < 2) — insignificant **and** wrong-signed
  (the upside-dominated names out-earned), flat in both eras (*t* = −0.26 / −1.44), only ≈1.9σ
  into the left tail of a 1,000-permutation placebo, with a clean 20-seed synthetic control that
  *does* recover a planted relation. The premium is a smaller-cap phenomenon; on mega-caps it is
  absent.
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** The specified book loses money net at any cost (−3.85 bps/day at 1 bp,
  −11.85 at 5 bps); the gross edge is not even reliably present, and the data-mined sign-flip is
  eaten by the round-trip friction at 1 bp.
